title: Property (T) above one-third density in random free-product quotients
strongest_verified_claim: For fixed n>=3 nontrivial finitely generated factors, fixed finite nonempty inverse-closed generating alphabets of nonidentity group elements, and fixed 1/3<d<1, the quotient by floor(|S_l|^d) independent uniform rooted cyclically reduced length-l syllable relators with replacement has property (T) with probability tending to one through all integer lengths. The stated linear-normal variant follows by thinning and quotient permanence.
